storage_order_note: Selection order, stratum and cell are recorded per entry. They are not the storage axis: overlaying the two is how a re-drawn manifest silently reorders a positionally joined array.
balancing_note: Outer axis first, then the axes inside it. The library stratum's NGG rows cluster, so evening all eight cells as one flat axis would return 80 NGG / 120 non-NGG.
